name: message
useFor: Build a conversation from Message rows inside a MessageGroup: MessageAvatar with an initial or a picture, MessageContent with a MessageHeader (the name, then a time element), the Bubble pieces and an optional MessageFooter (Delivered, Read). Set align end for the person's own messages; the row mirrors to the right.
constraints: Timestamps darker than the muted purple
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the inbox rows (sender in ink, date muted) and the rail's initial tile
